get.summary: Get server email settings without credentials
get.description: Administrator token required. Returns effective settings and credential presence flags; never returns the SMTP username or password. Uses Cache-Control: no-store.

patch.description: Administrator token required. Omitted fields, including credentials, retain their current values. Rejects any supplied environment-controlled field with 409 before saving. Validates the resulting SMTP configuration before writing when email is enabled or SMTP fields are supplied. Set smtpEncryption to an empty string for no encryption. Disabling SMTP authentication clears database credentials not controlled by the environment; credential fields are only saved when authentication is enabled. Disabling email preserves SMTP settings and invalidates pending password reset tokens; it is rejected while EMAIL_VERIFICATION_REQUIRED=1.

409.description: An affected field is controlled by an environment variable, or disabling email conflicts with required email verification.

delete.summary: Disable email and remove stored SMTP configuration
delete.description: Administrator token required. Removes all database-stored SMTP settings, disables email, and invalidates pending password reset tokens. Returns 409 without changes if any email or SMTP field is controlled by an environment variable, or EMAIL_VERIFICATION_REQUIRED=1. Repeated deletion returns 204.

204.description: Email disabled and stored SMTP configuration removed

409.description: An affected field is controlled by an environment variable, or disabling email conflicts with required email verification.

get.summary: List all user accounts

post.description: isEnabled and emailVerified default to true when omitted.

get.summary: Get a user account

patch.description: An administrator cannot disable their own account. Email changes follow the configured verification policy. A password change ends the user's web sessions but leaves personal API tokens active.

get.summary: Get users visible to the API token owner
get.description: Returns usernames of accounts visible to signed-in users, plus the token owner's own account even when it is private. Usernames are sorted alphabetically.

get.summary: Get dashboard overview statistics
get.description: Get the six overview values shown on the specified user's dashboard when their privacy setting permits access.

get.summary: Get dashboard row configuration

200.description: Configured dashboard rows, including hidden rows

put.description: The token must belong to the specified user. Submit every row exactly once with a unique zero-based position.

delete.description: The token must belong to the specified user.

get.summary: Get one visible dashboard row
get.description: Actor, actress, and director rows use the API token owner's hidden-person settings. Hidden rows return 404.

get.summary: Get individual plays of user
get.description: Returns one item per play, including plays with unknown dates. Sorted by watch date, position, and play ID.

post.summary: Create one play for a user
post.description: Creates exactly one play, including one with an unknown watch date. The movie is removed from the watchlist automatically.

get.summary: Get one individual play

put.description: All fields are required. The location must belong to the user. This operation does not change other plays on the same date.

delete.description: Deletes only the play identified by playId.

get.summary: Get movies in watchlist of user
get.description: Get all movies on the user watchlist. Sorted by most recently added on default.

post.summary: Add movies to watchlist of user

delete.summary: Delete movies from watchlist of user

put.summary: Add one movie to the user's watchlist
put.description: Adds the movie if absent. Repeating the request preserves the original addedAt timestamp.

delete.summary: Remove one movie from the user's watchlist
delete.description: Returns 204 even if the movie is not on the watchlist or does not exist.

get.summary: Get played movies of user
get.description: Get all played movies and their watch dates.

get.summary: List movies stored in Movary
get.description: Lists the server-wide movie catalog, including movies that may have been added through private user activity. This does not include personal watch data. Pages beyond the last page resolve to the last page. Sorting uses Movary ID as a tie-breaker.

get.summary: Get details of a movie stored in Movary
get.description: Returns shared movie metadata and external ratings. Personal plays, ratings, reviews, and watchlist state are not included.

post.description: Synchronously refreshes shared movie metadata from TMDB. Requires a personal API token.
Synchronously refreshes the shared IMDb rating from the ratings file when it has changed. A movie without an IMDb ID is left unchanged. Requires a personal API token.

get.summary: List persons stored in Movary
get.description: Lists the server-wide person catalog, including persons added through private user activity. Role filters match stored movie credits, independent of a user's watch history. Pages beyond the last page resolve to the last page. Sorting uses Movary ID as a tie-breaker.

parameters.name: role
parameters.description: Persons credited in the stored movie catalog

get.summary: Get details of a person stored in Movary
get.description: Returns shared person metadata. Personal movie credits and user preferences are not included.

post.description: Synchronously refreshes shared person metadata from TMDB. Requires a personal API token.

get.summary: Get available profile images for a person
get.description: Returns the TMDB profile images for a person stored in Movary. Requires an administrator's personal API token.

200.description: Available profile images and override state

put.summary: Select a profile image for a person
put.description: Selects an available TMDB profile image as the person's global image. Requires an administrator's personal API token.

delete.summary: Restore the default profile image for a person
delete.description: Removes the global image selection so the person uses TMDB's current default profile image. Requires an administrator's personal API token.

get.summary: Get available posters for a movie
get.description: Gets the English-language TMDB posters available for a movie. Requires an administrator's personal API token.

hasOverride.description: True when an administrator selected a poster instead of using TMDB's default.

put.summary: Select a poster for a movie
put.description: Selects one of the movie's available TMDB posters as its global poster. Requires an administrator's personal API token.

delete.summary: Restore the default poster for a movie
delete.description: Removes the global poster selection so the movie uses TMDB's current default poster. Requires an administrator's personal API token.

get.summary: List the authenticated user's locations
get.description: Location names are private to their owner, even when the user's movie data is shared.

put.summary: Update one of the authenticated user's locations

delete.summary: Delete one of the authenticated user's locations
delete.description: Succeeds when the location is already absent. Existing play entries are retained without that location assignment.

get.summary: Get the user's personal rating of a movie
get.description: Get the specified user's rating when their privacy setting permits access. Returns 404 when the movie has no rating.

put.summary: Create or update the user's personal rating of a movie
put.description: Set the authenticated user's rating for the specified movie.

delete.summary: Delete the user's personal rating of a movie
delete.description: Clear the authenticated user's rating. The operation succeeds when the movie exists but has no rating.

get.summary: Get the user's review of a movie
get.description: Get the specified user's review when their privacy setting permits access.

put.summary: Create or update the user's review of a movie
put.description: Create or replace the authenticated user's review for the specified movie.

delete.summary: Delete the user's review of a movie
delete.description: Delete the authenticated user's review for the specified movie. The operation succeeds when the movie exists but has no review.
